title: SAMPLE: Conflicting accounts of Ras Lanuf terminal status
summary: Two sample statements disagree on whether loading at Ras Lanuf had resumed. The conflict is recorded rather than averaged into a single 'market view'.
whatHappened: Statement A, attributed to a local operations contact, said loading had resumed. Statement B, attributed to a shipping agent note, said the terminal remained closed to commercial liftings. Neither document is an official NOC bulletin.
whyItMatters: Eastern export availability changes cargo planning. Presenting only one of two conflicting accounts would hide uncertainty that operators need to see.
watchNext: An official terminal or NOC notice that explicitly addresses loading status, or evidence that one of the two accounts has been withdrawn.
confidenceRationale: Two attributed claims conflict; neither is independently corroborated.

disputedClaims.claim: Loading at Ras Lanuf has resumed.
disputedClaims.note: Contradicted by Statement B. Not corroborated.

disputedClaims.claim: Ras Lanuf remains closed to commercial liftings.
disputedClaims.note: Contradicted by Statement A. Not corroborated.

corrections.summary: SAMPLE correction: an earlier draft sentence that treated Statement A as confirmed was removed. Both accounts are now labelled disputed.
